note: Self-employed mortgage loan officer running his own book, which is the 'owns their own business' shape, and health is unambiguously the neglected area — twelve years of decline while everything else was attended to. He is also not the excluded profile: he plays basketball, trains two to three times a week and is 190 lb at 5'11". He misses on the two that decide deals. Income fails on the affordability test rather than the salary one: $7,000 in joint savings he will not spend down, $1,000-1,500 monthly surplus already allocated, $6,000 total available credit, and a spouse-imposed $2,000 ceiling. And he is not good-to-great — 'I've come to the conclusion that I can't do it on my own anymore' is rescue framing, and the stated ICP explicitly excludes 'I need to just lose weight'. He is the clearest case in this batch of a prospect who fits the emotional profile the pitch is built for and fails the income screen the ICP is built on.
